text_to_image_prompt: Create ONE strict 2D orthographic top-down film-set PLAN for this single location. Image1 is spatial authority; other images provide its appearance. Straight narrow white stone palace return bridge over sea, stone balustrades on both sides, repeated pointed arch gateways, blue gold banners and crystal lamps, long central walking axis. Preserve single straight bridge, no extra branching bridge or island. Draw only this location's footprint, with black architectural linework and flat ivory/light blue fills. Top-down furniture footprints, thick wall or rock outlines, openings and fixed circulation. No wall elevations visible, no perspective, no isometric model, no realistic shadows. Do not draw any additional building, bridge, cave, courtyard, entry or connecting room not present in these references. For unshown edges use a plain closed boundary. Sparse SHORT English zone labels, no numbers or dimensions. Portrait 9:16. One plan fills the sheet. No people.
